email.body1:
Sheree, saw Schoox just picked up Lighthouse awards for frontline and practical AI.

Recognition like that usually pulls in more in-market accounts than the BD team can follow up on, and that is where good opportunities go quiet. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Schoox off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Sheree, quick follow-up for Schoox.

Most BD reps lose pipeline to follow-up volume, not a lack of accounts: there are simply more leads than hours to research and write to them well. Our AI SDR handles that end to end, lifting response rates 50 to 70 percent with built-in best practices.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?

Sheree, last bit of proof for Schoox.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to the CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Schoox's reply rate likely compares to other learning-tech vendors. Want to grab 15 minutes so I can walk you through it?
